scripts.analyze: tsc --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --skipLibCheck --outDir .analyze-build --noEmit false --declaration false --sourceMap false scripts/analyze-url.ts src/types/*.ts && node .analyze-build/scripts/analyze-url.js
scripts.test: tsc --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --skipLibCheck --outDir .test-build --noEmit false --declaration false --sourceMap false scripts/analyze-url.ts tests/*.ts src/types/*.ts && node --test .test-build/tests/analyze-url.test.js
